meta.title: Add insert SQL batching test and fix
meta.body_summary: Fix generate_insert_sql to return all batches and add tests covering SQL batching.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex fixed a generate_insert_sql batching bug with a test; self-merged by maintainer in ~21 min without review, only CI coverage bot.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 184 changed lines across 8 files, this is a small-scale fix. The core change (batching fix in anomstack/df/utils.py) is only 10 lines; most churn comes from test file replacement and alignment. The size supports a low-friction self-merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review was recorded; only bot coverage reports.
review_details.performance_claim: Fixing generate_insert_sql to return all batches enables proper batch INSERT execution, reducing the number of SQL round-trips and improving write throughput.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: missing_insert_batching (prior code did not return all batches)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A small SQL generation bugfix with straightforward batching logic; agent merged without friction under maintainer self-review.

detection_detail.ci_auto: GitHub Actions coverage bot posted coverage reports (64%) after each commit, confirming no coverage loss.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests (test_sql_utils.py initially, later replaced by test_df_utils.py) verify batching logic, but no before/after performance measurement or benchmark was provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions detected; PR merged immediately after second commit.

core_change_summary.description: In anomstack/df/utils.py, fixed generate_insert_sql to correctly yield all batched INSERT statements instead of returning only the first batch. Added initial batching test in test_sql_utils.py, later replaced by test_df_utils.py in a follow-up commit that also aligned with main and added Makefile coverage target.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Second commit (139f269c) merged main, added test_df_utils.py, removed test_sql_utils.py, and made minor doc/build updates unrelated to the batching fix.
change_trajectory: Commit 1 (1d4cd51a): Fixed generate_insert_sql to return all batches; added tests/test_sql_utils.py with batching tests.
Commit 2 (139f269c): Merged with main, replaced test_sql_utils.py with test_df_utils.py, added Makefile coverage target, and synced other minor changes.

review_signals.summary: Coverage report posted after each commit, showing 64% coverage maintained.

collaboration_trajectory: Maintainer opened PR with batching fix and initial test file.
GitHub Actions bot posted first coverage report.
Maintainer added a second commit to align with main and replace test file; coverage bot posted second report.
PR self-merged within ~21 minutes with no formal review or discussion.
